doc: Derivation sidecar of M3 (format: the docstrings and code of holon.derivation, holon.derivation.extract, holon.derivation.corpus and holon.derivation.product). Authored in the blind rerun from the target code only. extract: the Go frontend config spec/M2/lib/go_frontend.json and its document morph_derivation; the consumer is the node derivation function that turns a committed batch (geth.RPCRollupBatch) into blocks, (*BatchInfo).ParseBatch; the join is the function that builds that batch from the ABI-decoded BatchDataInput of the current Rollup commitBatch call, unpackModernRollupCall; no environment function is declared. The product and corpus sections are left empty: the deployment state, the compressor runs and the cases are not fixed by the target code.
